name: ChatGPT
summary: OpenAI's ChatGPT assistant on the web, desktop and mobile, which takes skills, MCP apps and plugins shared with Codex.

skills.what: Skills, folders with a SKILL.md that ChatGPT and Codex load, are available to eligible ChatGPT Business, Enterprise, Healthcare and Edu users.

mcp.what: ChatGPT connects to remote MCP servers at a public HTTPS endpoint; full MCP with write actions is on Business and Enterprise/Edu workspaces on the web (the FAQ calls it beta), Pro gets read/fetch only, and mobile is not supported.

sources.title: Connecting custom MCP servers in ChatGPT

plugins.what: Plugins combine skills, MCP servers and optional UI, published once to a directory shared by ChatGPT and Codex; a portable package uses a root plugin.json with the Agent Plugins 1.0.0 schema, and .codex-plugin/plugin.json and Claude-compatible manifests are also accepted.

hooks.what: Lifecycle hooks (hooks/hooks.json) load only for plugins installed manually in Codex desktop, which the page also places under ChatGPT Work; plugins with hooks are not eligible for the public directory.

scheduled-work.what: Scheduled tasks run one-time or recurring prompts, monitor for changes, and on paid plans respond to Gmail, Slack or GitHub events, with per-plan limits on active tasks.

sandboxes.what: Data analysis writes and runs Python in a stateful Jupyter notebook environment that ChatGPT provides, which cannot make external web requests or API calls.
